SELECT 
    gen.A_STOCKSNAME AS `股票名称`,
    gen.A_STOCKCODE AS `股票代码`,
    gen.ENDDATE AS `报表截止日`,
    ROUND(gen.P110100/100000000, 3) AS `营业总收入（亿）`
FROM VIEW_STK_INCOME_GEN gen
INNER JOIN GET_A_SEC_CODE code
    ON gen.COMCODE = code.COMCODE
WHERE 
    gen.A_STOCKSNAME LIKE '%万华化学%'
    AND gen.ENDDATE = '2025-12-31 00:00:00'
    AND gen.RPT_TYPE = '合并'
    AND gen.ISVALID = 1
    AND gen.P110100 IS NOT NULL
